about: Binyas, a Benjamite mule-driver of King Manasseh, is egged on by Karmin's jealous neighbours to slander Karmin before the king. He brings two false witnesses from Armathaim, who rehearse a common story on the road and repeat it to the king's satisfaction. The king orders Karmin's household put to the sword; the witnesses, meanwhile, feast with Karmin, until an angel wakes him to flee.

sentences.l: And-there-was one ፀዋግ (wretch?) from-seed-of Benjamin, whose-name Binyas, who he-draws mule-of king-of Israel, and-he-gives-drink-him Karmin with mule-of king Manasseh.
sentences.i: There was a certain base fellow (?) of the seed of Benjamin, named Binyas, who drew the mule of the king of Israel; and Karmin gave him drink (?), together with the mule of King Manasseh.
sentences.n: ወሀሎ 'and there was' (ወ- 'and' + ሀሎ 'he/it was'); ፩ is the numeral 'one', used like 'a certain'. ፀዋግ is uncertain (?): the glossary has 'wretched, base', and the context (he draws the king's mule) may suggest a servant or attendant (?); Dillmann not available. እም- 'from', ዘርአ 'seed-of' (construct), ዘ- 'who/whose' (ዘስሙ 'whose name'). 'King of Israel' and 'King Manasseh' are the same king — Bezold's text names Manasseh, the 'king' of the earlier chapters. በቅለ is read as 'mule' (?). ይሴስዮ ከርሚን: 'he gives to drink' (3ms imperfect, causative of the root s-t-y 'drink') + -o 'him, it'; who gives drink to whom is unclear (?). I take Karmin as the giver and Binyas as the one given drink along with the king's mule; the other reading, Binyas watering the mule at Karmin's, is possible (?). The Karmin story continues from earlier parts.

sentences.i: And they plied Binyas, the driver of the king's mule, with evil (?), and slandered him (?), and they said to him, 'This Karmin blasphemes! He has blasphemed against the king of Israel, the Lord's anointed, saying, "This king is not the son of a free woman but the son of an old slave woman, whom they bought for two measures of kor for the work of ማኅረጽ and ግንፋል;"
sentences.n: A long accusation; the quoted speech runs on through the semicolon. ወይዋሕይዎ ('they urge/work on him'?) and ወሐመይዎ ('and they slandered him'?) are uncertain (?) — I take both as the slanderers' approach; Dillmann not available; the (?) applies to the exact sense of both verbs. ሰሓቤ 'driver-of' (agent noun, construct; compare ይስሕብ in the first sentence). መሲሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his anointed, of God', the suffix -hu anticipating the owner (the king as the Lord's anointed, as Saul and David are called in Samuel). ወልደ አግዓዚት 'son of a free woman' (አግዓዚ 'free'), against ወልደ አመት 'son of a slave woman' (አመት), አረጋዊት 'aged' (fem.). ተሣየጥዋ 'they bought her' (ተሣየጠ 'buy' + object -wa). ቆሮስ is the kor, a large dry measure (Hebrew kor). ማኅረጽ and ግንፋል are obscure (?) — I take them as terms for menial work, such as grinding or sifting (?); the slander is that the king's mother was a bought household slave. ኢኮነ 'is/was not'. በክልኤ: በ- 'for' (the price) + the numeral 'two'; ለግብረ ማኅረጽ: ለ- 'for' + 'work-of' (construct).

sentences.i: And you, accuse him before the king and rebuke him, for we will be your witnesses before the king and we will not put you to shame.'
sentences.n: ተዋቀሦ and ዝልፎ are imperatives with object suffix -o 'him' ('accuse him', 'rebuke him'). ንከውነከ ስምዐ 'we will be to-you a witness' — ን- is the 1st-person plural prefix, -ka 'to you'; ስምዐ is accusative, 'as witness'. ኢናኀፍረከ 'we will not shame you' (ኀፈረ 'be ashamed' in its causative sense). በቅድመ 'before'. ስምዐ 'witness' (accusative) is from the same root as ሰማዕተ in the chapter title, which is the agent noun.

sentences.n: አቀሙ ኪዳነ 'they established a covenant' (አቀመ 'cause to stand, set up'); ከመ ይኩኑ 'that they be' (subjunctive). ዘኢተናገረ በልሳኑ — 'who did not speak with his tongue': ተናገረ is active here (a tä-stem, as in the glossed ተናገርዎ 'they spoke to him'), and ዘ- 'who' picks up Karmin, the accused, whose tongue and thought are clear of it. ኅሊናሁኒ: -ኒ is 'also, even'. ኢዐርገ 'did not go up' (ዐርገ 'ascend') — 'come up into the mind'. ጥቀ 'greatly', here with the negative 'not at all'. The unit ends with ፨, a stronger break than ።.

sentences.l: And-said king: Go-then, bring-them in-secret, that we-examine-them whether they-agree with your-word, and-we-cut his-head. And-he-went and-brought-them, Zeryos and-Karmelos, tribe-of Manasseh, for with-them he-had-agreed that not they-shame-him before king concerning witness-of their-falsehood.
sentences.i: And the king said, 'Go, then, and bring them secretly, so that we may examine them to see whether they agree with your word, and cut off his head.' And he went and brought them — Zeryos and Karmelos, of the tribe of Manasseh — for he had come to terms with them (?) that they would not shame him before the king over the witness of their falsehood.
sentences.n: ሖርኬ 'go, then' (imperative of ሖረ + the emphasizing -ኬ). አምጽኦሙ 'bring them' (imperative, caus. of መጽአ 'come'). ከመ ንጠይቆሙ 'that we examine them' (subjunctive 1pl, ጠየቀ 'examine, inquire into'); ለእመ 'if, whether'; የኀብሩ 'they agree' (ኀብረ, the same verb as in chapter 1). ንምትሮ ርእሶ 'that we cut off his head' (subjunctive 1pl, coordinated with the preceding 'that we examine them') (ምትረ 'cut off'). The names ዘርዮስ Zeryos and ካርሜሎስ Karmelos are in Geʿez form, not otherwise identified; ለ- before them marks the object. ነገደ 'tribe-of' (construct); ምነሴ is Manasseh as a tribe, spelled differently from ምናሴ the king. ተካየደ 'he made an agreement' (?) (subject Binyas; the sense is from context, and the glossary flags it as uncertain); ኢያኅፍርዎ 'that they not shame him' echoes the promise in the earlier sentence.

sentences.i: And by themselves, on the road, they took counsel together, saying, 'When we have told the king, if he questions us one by one, so that he may know the truth of our word, and he says to us, "Where did you hear this word?", let us say to him, "In private, while we were drinking wine with him";
sentences.n: Their rehearsed cover story begins here and runs through the next three units; each inner question is introduced by ወሶበ 'and when'. በባሕቲቶሙ 'by themselves' (ባሕቲት 'alone' + -omu 'their'); መከሩ 'they took counsel' (መከረ). ሶበ ነገርናሁ 'when we have told it' (1pl perfect + -hu). ተጠየቀነ 'he questions us' (tä-stem + -na 'us'; active, as ተስእሎሙ 'he questioned them' in a later sentence; a 1cp passive would be ተጠየቅነ) (?). በበ ባሕቲትነ 'each by himself, one by one' (repeated በ-). ጽድቀ 'truth-of' (construct). ንበሎ 'let us say to him' (subjunctive 1pl of ብህለ). እንዘ ንሰቲ 'while we drink' (እንዘ + imperfect = 'while'). ወይነ 'wine'. In ምስሌሁ 'with him', the 'him' is Karmin, the man they accuse; the king is 'him' in ንበሎ.

sentences.i: and when he says to us, "What day was it?", let us say to him, "On the day the new moon of the month just past appeared — a Thursday";
sentences.n: ምንት ዕለቱ 'what is its day?'. አመ 'on the day when' (አመ + perfect). ሠረቀ 'it rose', said of the sun or moon; ወርኅ is both 'month' and 'moon'. The phrase 'the new moon of the month just past' for አመ ሠረቀ ወርኅ እንተ ኀለፈት is my reading (?) — it could be 'when last month began'. ኀሙስ 'Thursday', literally 'fifth'. The relative and its verb are feminine, so 'month' takes feminine agreement here.

sentences.i: And when he asks us, saying, "With what did you drink it, and where were you?", let us say to him, "By golden lamps (?), and our seating was in a hall, together, in a ምፅንጋ (?), ዕ..."
sentences.n: ተስእለነ 'he asks us' (tä-stem, active, + the object -na; compare ተስእሎሙ 'he questioned them' below, and ተጠየቀነ above, the same type) (?). ሰተይክምዎ 'you (pl.) drank it'. ቀናዲል is the plural of ቀንዲል 'lamp' (?) — 'by golden lamps' is a strange answer to 'with what did you drink', so the sense is uncertain (?); Dillmann not available. ምንባሪነ 'our seat, our sitting' (a noun from the root of 'sit, dwell' + -na 'our', near መንበር 'seat'; the exact formation is uncertain) (?); -ሂ 'also'. ጽርሕ 'hall, chamber', the word used of the sanctuary in chapter 1. ምፅንጋ is unknown to me (?). The ዕ at the end of the quoted speech is as printed: a single letter, probably a fragment of a word or a damaged reading; I have not tried to complete it. sentences.i: As God commanded, kings and princes and all who sit on a high seat are to examine the judgment — as God commanded Moses.
sentences.n: The law of Moses on the examination of witnesses: Deuteronomy 19:15-19 (the judges shall make diligent inquiry; a false witness suffers what he planned for the accused) and Deuteronomy 17:6 (a charge stands on two or three witnesses). ይጠይቁ 'they examine' (jussive 3pl of ጠየቀ, the verb above). ፍትሐ 'judgment' is in the accusative, and ነገሥት ወመኳንንት 'kings and princes' are the subjects; the same ፍትሐ ነገሥት could be read as 'law of kings' (the name of a later Ethiopian law code), but then the verb has no subject (?). እለ ይነብሩ 'those who sit'. አዘዘ 'he commanded' / አዘዞ 'he commanded him'; ለ- before ሙሴ 'to Moses'.

sentences.i: Then was fulfilled upon them the prophecy of David, who said: 'Those who speak peace with their neighbours while evil is in their hearts — give them according to the evil of their deeds and according to the evil of their thoughts.'
sentences.n: The allusion is to Psalm 28:3-4 (LXX 27:3-4): 'who speak peace with their neighbours while evil is in their hearts', followed by the plea 'give them according to their deeds'. David is called a prophet, as in Acts 2:30. አሜሃኬ 'then indeed' (አሜሃ 'then' + -ኬ). ተፈጸመ 'was fulfilled' (passive of ፈጸመ). ትንቢተ 'prophecy-of' (construct). ዘይቤ 'who/which said' (relative + 3ms perfect of the defective verb). ቢጾሙ 'their neighbours' (ቢጽ 'fellow, neighbour'). ሀቦሙ 'give them' (imperative of ወሀበ). እከየ 'evil-of' (construct), ምግባሮሙ 'their deeds', ኅሊናሆሙ 'their thoughts'. The wording of the Geʿez, not its source text, is what I render.

sentences.l: and-take from-your-goods as-much-as you-can what you-wished, and-flee into land-of other, for killer-of prophets and-seeker-of blood-of innocents he, Manasseh.
sentences.i: and take of your goods as much as you can, whatever you have wished, and flee to a foreign land; for he is a killer of prophets and a seeker of the blood of the innocent (?) — Manasseh.'
sentences.n: ወንሣእ 'and take!' (imperative of ነሥአ); መጠነ 'as much as', ትክል 'you are able', ዘፈቀድከ 'which you wished'. ጒይይ 'flee!' (imperative). ብሔረ 'land-of' (construct) ባዕድ 'other, foreign'. ቀታሌ ነቢያት 'killer-of prophets' (agent noun in the construct); Manasseh's killing of the prophets is a later Jewish and Christian tradition (that he had Isaiah sawn in two), beside 2 Kings 21:16 ('he shed very much innocent blood'). ኀሣሤ ደመ ንጹሓን 'seeker-of the blood of the innocent' — I read ኀሣሤ ደም as one who hunts down or demands blood, hence 'seeker of the blood' (?). ውእቱ ምናሴ 'he (is) Manasseh', a closing clause with the predicate first.

'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እኪት: እኩይ — evil, wicked (adjective, fem. እኪት; masc. እኩይ)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኪዳነ: ኪዳን — covenant (noun, m.; construct 'covenant of') · accusative 'a covenant' as object (ሀበኒኬ ኪዳነ 'give me a covenant')
glossary.ካርሚን: ካርሚን — Karmin (proper name; a spelling beside ከርሚን)
glossary.ወሀሎ: ሀሎ — and he was, he lived (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, h-l-w)
glossary.ወለሊሁኒ: ለሊሁ — and he himself also (ወ- + ለሊ 'self' + -ሁ '3ms' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወሐመይዎ: ሐመየ — and they slandered, reviled him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወሐተቶሙ: ሐተተ — and he examined them (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወመሐሉ: መሐለ — and swear! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, ወመሐሉ ሊተ) · and they swore (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ወመሐሉ ሎቱ) (G, m-ḥ-l)
glossary.ወመስቴሆሙ: መስቴ — and their drink, drinking (ወ- 'and' + noun, stem መስቴ- + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; citation form uncertain (?))
glossary.ወመናብርቲሆሙ: መንበር — and their seats (ወ- 'and' + plural መናብርት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወመኳንንት: መኰንን — and nobles, governors (ወ- + plural መኳንንት)
glossary.ወምንባሪነሂ: ምንባር — and our seat, our sitting, also (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun from n-b-r + -ነ '1cp our' + enclitic -ሂ 'also'; noun formation uncertain (?))
glossary.ወርኅ: ወርኅ — moon, month (noun; construct 'of the moon')
glossary.ወሰዐቶ: ሰዐት — and its hour (ወ- 'and' + noun, fem. + -o '3ms its')
glossary.ወበርበሮ: በርበረ — and his plunder (noun) · or 'and plunder him' (ወ- 'and' + verb + -o '3ms him') (?); form and lemma uncertain (?)
glossary.ወበባሕቲቶሙ: ባሕቲት — and by themselves (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'by' + noun 'solitude' + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበዛቲ: ዛቲ — and in this (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in' + fem. demonstrative 'this')
glossary.ወብሩሮ: ብሩር — and his silver (ወ- 'and' + noun + -o '3ms his')
glossary.ወተስእሎሙ: ተስእለ — and he asked them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem, s-ʾ-l + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወተናገርዎ: ተናገረ — and they spoke to him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt, n-g-r + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወኀሣሤ: ኀሣሢ — and seeker of (ወ- 'and' + agent noun of ኀሠሠ 'seek', construct state 'seeker-of')
glossary.ወነገርዎ: ነገረ — and they told him (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, G + -ዎ 3ms object)
glossary.ወነገሮ: ነገረ — and he told him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወንምትሮ: ምትረ — and that we cut off it/him (ወ- 'and' + 1cp subjunctive, G + -o '3ms him, it')
glossary.ወንሰቲ: ሰትየ — and we drink (ወ- 'and' + 1cp imperfect/subjunctive, G)
glossary.ወኖሙ: ኖመ — and they slept (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወአምጽእ: አምጽአ — and bring! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative of መጽአ, ʾ-m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወአምጽኦሙ: አምጽአ — and he brought them (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative of መጽአ + -ኦሙ '3mp them') · and bring them! (imperative)
glossary.ወአቀሙ: አቀመ — and they established (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ቆመ)
glossary.ወአንቅሆ: አንቅሀ — and wake him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative + -ኦ 'him', caus. of ነቅሀ; doubled by ለኤልምያኖስ) · and he woke him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ነቅሀ + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.ወአድኅን: አድኀነ — and save! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ወኢናኀፍረከ: አኀፈረ — and we will not shame you (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp imperfect, causative of ኀፈረ 'be ashamed' + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ወኢአንስት: ብእሲት — and not female (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + plural አንስት of ብእሲት 'woman')
glossary.ወኢያምሥጥከ: አምሠጠ — and let (one) not escape you (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive of አምሠጠ 'escape', ʾa-prefixed verb + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ወእሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — and they, indeed (ወ- + 3mp pronoun + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወእምጎሩ: ጎር — and from his neighbour (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + noun 'neighbour' + -u '3ms his')
glossary.ወእንስሳሁ: እንስሳ — and his livestock (ወ- 'and' + noun, collective + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
glossary.ወወርቆ: ወርቅ — and his gold (ወ- 'and' + noun + -o '3ms his')
glossary.ወዐዘቅት: ዐዘቅት — and well, pit (ወ- 'and' + noun, fem.)
glossary.ወዕለቶ: ዕለት — and its day (ወ- 'and' + noun, fem. + -o '3ms its')
glossary.ወዕግታ: ዐገተ — and surround it! (ወ- 'and' + 2ms imperative + -ኣ '3fs it'; sense 'surround, shut in') (?)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዝልፎ: ዘለፈ — and rebuke him! (ወ- 'and' + 2ms imperative ዝልፍ + -o '3ms him')
glossary.ወይሴስዮ: ሴሰየ — he fed, gave food or drink (?) (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect + -o 'him'; lemma and sense uncertain (?))
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይብለነ: ብህለ — and he says to us (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect/subjunctive, defective G + -ለነ 'to us')
glossary.ወይነ: ወይን — wine (noun, accusative) · 'vine' (ትተክል ወይነ 'you will plant a vine')
glossary.ወይዋሕይዎ: ዋሕየ — and they ply/urge him (?) (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; root and sense uncertain (?))
glossary.ወይዌድስዎ: ወደሰ — praise, extol (3mp imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወገብኡ: ገብአ — and they returned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወግንፋል: ግንፋል — and ግንፋል (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun of uncertain sense (?))
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')
glossary.ዕ: ዕ — a single letter as printed, fragment of a word or damaged reading (?); not completed
glossary.ዘሰምዐ: ሰምዐ — what he heard (ዘ- 'what' + 3ms perfect, G) · who heard, the one who heard (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘኢተናገረ: ተናገረ — who did not speak (ዘ- 'who' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ዘእምአርማቴም: አርማቴም — who (is) from Armathaim (ዘ- 'who' + እም- 'from' + place name, Ramathaim)
glossary.ዘይስሕብ: ሰሐበ — which draws, drags (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዘፈቀድከ: ፈቀደ — what you wished (ዘ- + 2ms perfect, G, f-q-d)
glossary.ያርሕቅዎ: አርሕቀ — that they remove him far (3mp subjunctive, causative of ርሕቀ 'be far' + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ያእምር: አእመረ — that he may know (3ms subjunctive of አእመረ 'know', a verb with ʾa- prefix, not a true causative)
glossary.ይምትሩ: ምትረ — that they cut off (3mp subjunctive, G)
glossary.ይቀንኡ: ቀንአ — they are jealous, envy (3mp imperfect, G)
glossary.ይቤለነ: ብህለ — he said to us, he says to us (3ms perfect ይቤ + -ለነ 'to us'; of a hypothetical future in context)
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይነብሩ: ነበረ — they live, dwell (3mp imperfect, G, n-b-r) · they sit, are seated (3mp imperfect, G, of sitting on a seat)
glossary.ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይፀርፍ: ፀረፈ — he blasphemes, slanders (3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ይፈቅዲ: ፈቀደ — they wish, want (3mp imperfect, G; printed ይፈቅዲ, the expected form is ይፈቅዱ)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ጸውዖ: ጸውዐ — he summoned him (3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him'; also imperative 'call him!')
glossary.ፀዋግ: ፀዋግ — wretched, base (adj.); sense uncertain: elsewhere in this text it names a low fellow, and in a Proverbs 6:12 citation a worthless man
glossary.ፍትሐ: ፍትሕ — judgment, justice (noun, accusative) · construct 'judgment of' (ፍትሐ ሕዝበ አምላከ እስራኤል 'judgment of the people of the God of Israel')
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53)
glossary.፪: ፪ — 2, spoken ክልኤቱ (kəlʾetu) 'two'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'two' (ዘእንበለ ፪ በትር 'except two rods')
glossary.፸፮: ፸፮ — numeral 76, spoken ሰብዓ ወስድስቱ (säbʿa wä-sədstu) 'seventy-six'; here the chapter number (numeral)
